text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro McQueen was to participate 
in an on-campus mock race held as part of 
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So this is only good for 2nd place, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I gave it my all, but when it 
comes down to a battle in the final 
stretch, after all..."

Ever since her debut race, at Mejiro 
McQueen's request, we've been tailoring 
her training toward the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

However, this long-term plan centers 
primarily around basic physical 
conditioning. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, isn't she the Mejiro family's 
prized prodigy? I heard she's ridiculously 
talented—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, it was pretty iffy, wasn't 
it? Her reactions were sluggish, and it 
felt like she just couldn't adapt to the 
race..."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that girl. I hear she's still only 
doing basic training.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Basic training?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
That's surely why she hasn't been able to 
adapt to the race.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Putting off practical training to win, 
huh... Does that mean you're just that 
confident?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But if we dawdle around here, we 
won't make it in time for next year's 
Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I could never do that if it were me. The 
girls I train would want to compete in the 
Classics too.

âIt's true that your current training 
regimen isn't built around winning 
immediate races.

"Still, with her caliber, she's more than 
capable of keeping up with our current 
training. She must know that herself, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Earth to Trainer! ...What is the 
matter with you, spacing out like that?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?

The next day, Mejiro McQueen told me that 
she "wanted to talk" after training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san... Could you look this 
way, please?

Mejiro McQueen showed me a note. Written 
on it was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I tried coming up with a new training 
routine in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Building long-term stamina is important, 
but I was wondering if we should also 
consider ways to win in the Junior 
Class...

She seemed somewhat awkward and uneasy. 
Wait... could it be that she—
choice_data_list: Did someone say something to you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...! No, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway, please do consider the menu!

Mejiro McQueen hurried away as if trying 
to flee...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Is that you over there, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You're looking down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, looked like you were 
in a mock race earlier... Did something 
happen?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Actually, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It feels like Trainer is taking the blame 
because of me...

Mejiro McQueen talked to me about what had 
been troubling her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that's why you want to change 
the training menu, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But is that really what you and your 
Trainer want, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you promise we'd work hard together 
toward our goal of the Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then they must be wanting to keep that 
promise, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Both McQueen and Trainer.

...Mejiro McQueen likely made such a 
proposal in order to protect her Trainer.

However—that concern is completely 
unnecessary.
choice_data_list:
I can't let myself be the one holding 
everyone back...!

text_block_list.text:
The next day, I decided to talk with 
Mejiro McQueen once more.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, I am terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Please forget what I said yesterday about 
the self-training routine!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That was, um... not what I really meant, 
so...
choice_data_list: So that really was it, huh.
So that really was it, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: S... So you noticed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I believe our 
current regimen is fine as is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because I promised my Trainer that we 
would aim for the Tenno Sho together!
choice_data_list: Then, there's no need to hesitate.
Then, there's no need to hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I will continue to do my very best 
for the spring Tenno Sho...!

No matter what anyone says, our goal will 
not change. Together with Mejiro McQueen, 
I renewed my vow.
